description: Phase 3: s-checklist orphan component wiring (Tasks 10-16). Wire 12 existing but orphaned Vue components in s-checklist/ directory to the rendering pipeline via wp_code_overrides.json and htmlRendererRegistry. Depends on FEAT-001 for the 12 new componentType strings in VALID_COMPONENT_TYPES.
steps: 1. Read context.json first. Use openpyxl (via python script) to read the 5 S-cycle templates and extract exact internal sheet tab names: S1 (backend/wp_templates/S/S1 对被审计单位违反法规行为的考虑2019.xlsx), S8 (S8 租赁.xlsx), S9 (S9 对电子商务的考虑.xlsx), S10 (S10 对环境事项的考虑.xlsx), S17 (S17 非经常性损益.xls). Record all sheet tab names. These will be used for Group B overrides in wp_code_overrides.json. Note: S17 is .xls format — openpyxl may not read it; try xlrd or record the known sheet names from the component code (S17-1/S17-2/S17-3 based on component names).

2. Verify the 12 s-checklist component files exist by reading audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/s-checklist/index.ts (already confirmed: 12 exports). For each component, spot-check that props/field bindings are reasonable against the template column structures from step 1. Record any field offset issues in findings.

3. Verify useSSpecialImportExport.ts endpoint works: read the file (already confirmed at audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/composables/useSSpecialImportExport.ts) — it uses /api/s-special/{wp_id}/export-template, /api/s-special/{wp_id}/export-data, /api/s-special/{wp_id}/import-data. Grep backend for these endpoints to confirm they exist. Record in findings.

4. Edit backend/app/data/wp_code_overrides.json — Group A (7 entries already present, change componentType from 'a-program-console' to dedicated types): S9-1→'s9-adjudication', S9-2→'s9-internal-control', S10-1→'s10-adjudication', S10-2→'s10-internal-control', S17-1→'s17-nonrecurring-detail', S17-2→'s17-reconciliation', S17-3→'s17-tax-impact'. LEAVE S17-11 and S17-21 as 'a-program-console' (no corresponding components).

5. Edit backend/app/data/wp_code_overrides.json — Group B (5 new entries for internal sheets): Add entries with keys '{parent_wp_code}-{exact_sheet_tab_name}' for the 5 internal sheets identified in step 1. These route S1-1→'s1-regulation-record', S8-1→'s8-adjudication', S9-3→'s9-legal-regulations', S9-4→'s9-program-description', S10-3→'s10-environmental-regulations'. The exact key format must use the real xlsx tab name (e.g., 'S1-对法律法规的考虑记录表' or similar — determined by openpyxl reading).

6. Edit audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/htmlRendererRegistry.ts: Add 12 new type literals to the HtmlComponentType union: 's1-regulation-record', 's8-adjudication', 's9-adjudication', 's9-internal-control', 's9-legal-regulations', 's9-program-description', 's10-adjudication', 's10-internal-control', 's10-environmental-regulations', 's17-nonrecurring-detail', 's17-reconciliation', 's17-tax-impact'. Place them in the S-section between existing s6 and s12 entries.

7. Edit audit-platform/frontend/src/components/workpaper/registry/entries/specialized.ts: Add 12 new HtmlRendererEntry objects, each with defineAsyncComponent(() => import('../../s-checklist/ComponentName.vue')). Follow the exact pattern of existing S entries (icon, label in Chinese, emits: ['save', 'completed'], contextProps: 'standard'). Component mapping: s1-regulation-record→S1RegulationRecordSheet, s8-adjudication→S8AdjudicationSheet, s9-adjudication→S9AdjudicationSheet, s9-internal-control→S9InternalControlSheet, s9-legal-regulations→S9LegalRegulationsSheet, s9-program-description→S9ProgramDescriptionSheet, s10-adjudication→S10AdjudicationSheet, s10-internal-control→S10InternalControlSheet, s10-environmental-regulations→S10EnvironmentalRegulationsSheet, s17-nonrecurring-detail→S17NonRecurringDetailSheet, s17-reconciliation→S17ReconciliationSheet, s17-tax-impact→S17TaxImpactSheet.

8. Verify the contract test or registry spec file covers the new types. Check if htmlRendererRegistry.spec.ts or a contract test exists that validates all registered types. If so, ensure it won't fail with the new types (it should auto-discover from the registry). If there's an explicit list, add the 12 new types.
acceptance_criteria: wp_code_overrides.json Group A: 7 entries changed from a-program-console to dedicated componentTypes
wp_code_overrides.json Group B: 5 new per-sheet override entries added with correct tab names
htmlRendererRegistry.ts type union includes all 12 new types
specialized.ts has 12 new entry objects with correct lazy imports pointing to s-checklist/ components
S17-11 and S17-21 remain as a-program-console (not changed)
No regression in existing registry tests
verification: cd audit-platform/frontend ; npx vitest run src/components/workpaper --reporter=verbose

.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import json; d=json.loads(open('backend/app/data/wp_code_overrides.json','r',encoding='utf-8').read()); assert d.get('S9-1')=='s9-adjudication'; assert d.get('S17-11')=='a-program-console'; print('overrides OK')"
findings: 1. Sheet tab names extracted via openpyxl: S1 has 'S1-1对法律法规的考虑记录表', S8 has '审定表S8-1', S9 has '电子商务法律法规'+'程序说明', S10 has '环境法规'. S17 (.xls) read via xlrd: '审定表S17-1'/'审核表（合并）S17-2'/'审核表（个别报表）S17-3' + S17-11/S17-21 program sheets. 2. All 12 s-checklist component Vue files confirmed present. No field offset issues found on spot check. 3. Backend /api/s-special/{wp_id}/* endpoints NOT found in backend code (0 grep hits). useSSpecialImportExport.ts references them but they are not yet implemented — this is a known gap for FEAT-003 or future work. 4. Group A: 7 overrides changed (S9-1/S9-2/S10-1/S10-2/S17-1/S17-2/S17-3). S17-11 and S17-21 verified still a-program-console. 5. Group B: 5 new per-sheet overrides added using exact tab names from openpyxl. 6. htmlRendererRegistry.ts type union updated with 12 new types between s6 and s12. 7. specialized.ts: 12 new HtmlRendererEntry objects added with correct lazy imports to s-checklist/ components. 8. htmlRendererRegistry.spec.ts expected list updated with 12 new types. 47 tests passed, 0 failed.
